title: feat(motion): equal depth steps as an opt-in ladder parameter
body:
## What changed

- The default depth ladder does not change. It keeps the remainder in the last step. `top 20, bottom 2, stepdown 5` cuts `[15, 10, 5, 2]`.
- A new operation parameter, `equal_steps`, is in the `links.approach` object. The default is off.
- With `equal_steps` on, the ladder cuts the same number of levels in equal steps. The same example cuts `[15.5, 11, 6.5, 2]`.
- `camcraft_motion::machining2d::equal_stepdown` gives the stepdown of the equal ladder. The level law `cut_levels_under` walks it. There is still one level law.
- `cut_levels_for(top, &approach, bottom, stepdown)` reads the mode and the stock top from the approach. These ladders call it: 2D Pocket (rings, adaptive, HSM, trochoidal, avoid), 2D Adaptive rest, 2D Contour, Slot, Bore, Circular (and its vault rings), 3D Pocket (plain, shell, rest refine).
- With stock above Top Z (#2004), the level at Top Z stays. The steps below it are equal.
- The project file writes `equal_steps` only when it is on. Older files load without a change.
- The params digest takes one byte only when the mode is on. The stamp of each existing operation does not change.
- The pocket region law of the app (`operation::area::ladder_planes`) reads the same mode through `OpParams::ladder_stepdown`. The region is built at the planes that the generator cuts.
- The Lead in / Lead out tab has one new row, "Equal depth steps", in the Linking group.
- `docs/decisions/2012-equal-steps.md` records the decision.

The parameter is undoable through `EditOperationParams`. The MCP `edit_operation` patch reaches it as `params.links.approach.equal_steps`. No new command and no new MCP tool are necessary.

## Cause

Issue #2012 asks for a decision between a remainder last step and equal steps. The level law had only the remainder ladder. The project rule "CAM choices are parameters" asks for a parameter with a default.

## Scope limit

Face, Trace, Engrave and Trochoidal Slot have no `links` object. They cannot save the parameter and keep the remainder ladder. Issue #2832 adds the parameter to them. Turning has its own infeed laws and is not part of this change.

## UI screenshots

The images show the Lead in / Lead out tab before and after the new row.
The before image uses the same merged scene with only the new row removed.
A temporary CPU renderer drew the real egui meshes, fonts and textures.
The test harness uses a placeholder viewport. The environment has no WGPU adapter.
No capture code or images are in the PR branch.

![Before: Linking group without Equal depth steps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d20bbdb08204c89873c18935732cf7039c10375c/pr-2842/leads-before.png)

![After: Linking group with Equal depth steps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mkinney/Camcraft/d20bbdb08204c89873c18935732cf7039c10375c/pr-2842/leads-after.png)

## Tests

Pins in `crates/motion/tests/equal_steps.rs`:

- `the_default_ladder_keeps_the_remainder_and_equal_steps_is_opt_in`
- `equal_steps_keep_the_level_count_and_never_pass_the_stepdown`
- `equal_steps_keep_the_level_at_top_z_under_stock`
- `equal_steps_refuse_what_the_remainder_ladder_refuses`
- `a_pocket_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_pocket_with_keepouts_and_relief_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_trochoidal_adaptive_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_contour_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_slot_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_bore_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_circular_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `a_3d_pocket_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`

Pins in `crates/app/tests/equal_steps.rs`:

- `edit_sets_equal_steps_and_undo_restores_the_remainder_ladder`
- `the_project_file_writes_equal_steps_only_when_on_and_reads_it_back`
- `the_stamp_tells_the_two_ladders_apart`
- `the_region_law_reads_the_stepdown_of_the_ladder_mode`
- `the_generated_contour_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`
- `mcp_edit_operation_reaches_equal_steps`

Red before the change: yes. The motion pin did not compile on `upstream/main` 3970d3d03 (`Approach` has no field `equal_steps`; `cut_levels_for` and `equal_stepdown` do not exist).

Mutation results:

- Mutation 1: `ladder_stepdown` ignores the mode. Result: red. 10 of the 11 motion pins fail. The refusal pin stays green, which is correct.
- Mutation 2: the 12 caller files are the files of `upstream/main`, and the new law stays. Result: red. The 7 operation pins fail. The 4 law pins stay green.
- Mutation 3: the digest byte and the DTO write are removed. Result: red. `the_stamp_tells_the_two_ladders_apart`, `the_project_file_writes_equal_steps_only_when_on_and_reads_it_back` and `mcp_edit_operation_reaches_equal_steps` fail.
- After each mutation the code was restored and the pins were green again.

The first stamp pin did not fail in mutation 3. A default approach hashes no bytes, so each approach that is not the default already has a different stamp. The pin now also compares two approaches that are not the default.

Gate on the reviewed-finding fix:

- Head: `db53a0a827db8d3a59b518e1960f1f862198e0cd`. It merges `upstream/main` at `81407b31bab58d4037bbae90b18bbecfe9229103`.
- The merge conflict affected imports only. Both import sets stay. `pocket_avoid_with_relief` calls `cut_levels_for`.
- New pin: `a_pocket_with_keepouts_and_relief_cuts_the_levels_of_its_mode`. It checks both ladders with keep-outs and dogbone relief endpoints.
- Caller mutation: bypass `cut_levels_for`. The pin is RED on the equal cut planes. Restore: GREEN.
- Relief mutation: suppress corner relief. The pin is RED on the missing bottom relief endpoint. Restore: GREEN.
- Law mutation: ignore the equal mode. Eleven pins are RED. The refusal pin stays GREEN. Restore: all 12 motion pins GREEN.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. 163 of 164 steps pass in 22.8 minutes. Both motion and app `equal_steps` suites pass.
- The one failed step is `ui suites: lib`: 1,278 passed, seven failed, seven ignored. All seven failures report `No adapter found`.
- The explicit UI library rerun has the same result in 54.50 seconds. Neither run has a SIGSEGV.
- The seven failures are six `egui_app::report_tests` capture tests and `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. The environment exposes no WGPU adapter.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN on this head.
- The final worktree has no capture helper, review evidence or image files. The merge takes main's process version without a manual edit.

File length: `crates/motion/src/approach.rs` was 440 lines and is now 446. `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs` is now 402 lines.

## Latest review validation

Head: `db53a0a827db8d3a59b518e1960f1f862198e0cd` (unchanged). No source change was required by the latest review.

- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: RED. 232 of 233 steps passed in 32.4 minutes.
- Motion heavy tests: 56 passed, zero failed. App heavy tests: 40 passed, one failed. Nine known-fail checks passed as expected.
- The failed pin is `the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` in `app:pocket3d_hsm`.
- The failure is the path count assertion at `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs:144`. Actual counts are `(3158, 3130, 1141)`.
- This platform uses the unmeasured macOS count range documented with #2371. Earlier safety assertions pass.
- Baseline check: remove all PR source changes in motion and app. Run the exact ignored heavy pin. It fails with the same counts.
- Restore the source and run the exact pin again. It fails with the same counts. `git diff --exit-code` passes after restoration.
- This count failure therefore predates the PR source changes. No count range was changed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: RED. 163 of 164 steps passed in 26.1 minutes.
- Motion: 1,046 passed, zero failed, 54 ignored. App: 1,002 passed, zero failed, 18 ignored.
- All 12 motion `equal_steps` pins and all six app `equal_steps` pins pass.
- UI library in quick: 1,278 passed, seven failed, seven ignored. The other selected UI targets pass.
- Explicit UI library rerun from `crates/ui`: the same counts in 37.23 seconds. Neither run has a SIGSEGV.
- All seven UI failures report `No adapter found`. They are the six report capture tests and `headless_run_succeeds` named in the review.
- This machine reports an Apple M3 Max GPU with Metal support. The test process finds no Metal adapter.
- A passing local UI library run with an accessible graphics adapter remains required.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN.
- All commands ran locally with sccache disabled. No tests were skipped to obtain a pass.
- No source, test, screenshot, log, evidence file, or process version was committed. The PR stays a draft.

## Goldens moved

None. `git diff --stat upstream/main...HEAD -- "*.nc" "*.cl" "*.cnc"` is empty. The default ladder is the same.

## Not exercised

- No pin generates these ladders with the mode on: the 2D Adaptive rest ladder, the Circular vault rings, the 3D Pocket shell and rest-refine ladders, the rotary and multi-axis roughing. They call the same function as the pinned ladders.
- No pin generates a pocket on a part with the mode on. `the_region_law_reads_the_stepdown_of_the_ladder_mode` pins the stepdown that the region law reads, not the region.
- Code that reads `stepdown` as a bound is not changed (the 3-D shell floor below a plane, the first entry height of the contour). With equal steps it reads a bound a little larger than the real step. The decision file records this.
- The new UI row has no test of its own. No snapshot PNG is changed.
- The heavy lanes ran on the final head. See the validation results below.
- Nothing was run on a machine or in the stock simulation.

## Overlaps

- #2678 (`needs-rework`, `conflicts`) changes `crates/motion/src/machining3d/entry.rs`. It replaces the same `cut_levels_under` calls with its own `floor_levels::cut_levels`. It also changes `levels.rs`, but in `run_level_walks`, which this PR does not change. This PR is not stacked on #2678, because #2678 does not merge with `main` now. Whichever merges second refreshes, and must keep the mode in the 3-D ladder.
- #2796 changes `crates/app/src/operation/area.rs`, in a different function. Whichever merges second refreshes.
- #2716 and #2714 change `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs`. This PR does not change that file.

Build note: the shared sccache server on the build machine did not answer. The tests and gates ran with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1`.

Effort: high

Changelog: Depth ladder: new operation parameter "Equal depth steps" (off by default) cuts the same number of levels in equal steps; the default ladder keeps the remainder in the last step (#2012).

Fixes #2012
